visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An orange and white cat is seen lying on its back on a bright pink yoga mat, which is placed on a light-colored wooden floor. The cat is rolling side to side, and its paws are curled. A white air purifier is visible in the background, along with a wooden bed frame and some electrical cords. White text overlays appear at the bottom. (2) The cat transitions to a crouching position, eyeing a small, tan stuffed mouse toy attached to a thin white string being manipulated from off-camera. The cat pounces toward the toy with quick, agile movements. (3) The cat engages in a series of rapid rolls and kicks, biting and scratching the toy mouse aggressively on the pink mat. The lighting is bright and even, coming from an indoor source. More text captions appear intermittently as the cat continues its vigorous activity. (4) The cat abruptly stops and lies motionless on its side, panting slightly with its mouth open. The toy mouse rests near its head. A final set of text overlays and a small emoji appear on the screen as the cat stares blankly toward the camera.
